description: This file defines the 'StatisticsConfig' interface providing configuration settings for a statistics actor, including methods to retrieve timeout durations, update intervals, shard configurations, and a static factory method to create config instances from an actor context.

classes.name: StatisticsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the statistics actor, including timeout durations, update interval, lifetime, shard configurations, and a static method to instantiate from actor system settings.

classes.name: StatisticsConfig.ConfigValues
classes.description: Enum holding configuration path expressions and default values for various stats settings, implementing 'KnownConfigValue'.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout for asking other cluster members for information.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for updating public statistics.

methods.name: getDetailsExpireAfter
methods.description: Returns the lifetime configuration of statistics details.

methods.name: getShards
methods.description: Returns the list of shard configurations for reporting statistics.

methods.name: forActor
methods.description: Creates a 'StatisticsConfig' instance based on the supplied actor context's system configuration.
